scope: Only the pinned 64x48 independent Frost fixture. This is a test specification, not a runnable GPU config or runtime receipt. Tolerances are strict initial acceptance policies, not proven all-device WGSL error bounds.

comparator.premultipliedRgb: abs(actualRGB * actualAlpha / 255 - expectedRGB * expectedAlpha / 255); own alpha for each array, no intermediate rounding
comparator.coverage: All pixels and RGB channels; no edge, transparent-pixel or activity exclusions. Alpha compared independently as raw bytes. Returned native bytes already use RGBA order, even for BGRA storage.

gates.reason: Chosen before any production output using unchanged independent f64/BigInt expectations and hypothetical 8-bit premultiply/unpremultiply quantization. Do not tune thresholds against future production frames.

hardInvariantsBeforeScalarGates.identity: Pin original fixture/expected/source, source manifest, completed matching default/diagnostic build receipts, packages, actual delivered WASM response hash/size, resolver and raster API observations, selected backend and format. Namespace import or caller booleans are insufficient. Missing runtime identity leaves runtime acceptance unproved.
hardInvariantsBeforeScalarGates.dimensionsAndLayout: Exact 64x48 dimensions and 12288-byte RGBA arrays; no missing, inherited, nonnumeric or nonfinite metrics/gates; no silent channel swap or length repair.
hardInvariantsBeforeScalarGates.alpha: Every source and output alpha byte equals the authored source alpha byte.
hardInvariantsBeforeScalarGates.transparentActiveNative: All 109 authored-alpha-zero pixels in every active native frame are exactly RGBA0. Premultiplied error alone cannot detect hidden RGB leaks.
hardInvariantsBeforeScalarGates.sourceOpaque: All 2539 opaque pixels remain RGB-byte-identical through Canvas source ingress.

plateau.rule: Independently defined positive-alpha full-melt plateau equals original source RGBA exactly. Transparent plateau pixels equal RGBA0, not authored poison RGB.

hardInvariantsBeforeScalarGates.emptyCases: Both bypass cases require zero actual native resolver passes and exact original source/expected fixture bytes; they are not GPU readback evidence.
hardInvariantsBeforeScalarGates.defaultDiagnosticCanonicalPair: For each matching case, default canvasRgba equals diagnostic canvasRgba bytewise.
hardInvariantsBeforeScalarGates.doNotRequire: Canonical-ingress Canvas and raw-ingress Canvas need not be byte-identical. Their inputs differ honestly.

preOutputRationale.recordKind: Independent stdout-only mathematical/quantization analysis, not production measurements
preOutputRationale.sourceQuantizationAssumption: Nearest 8-bit premultiply/unpremultiply. Partial-alpha premultiplied error <= 0.5 + 96/(2*255) = 0.6882352941; whole-frame mean <= 424/3072 * 0.6882352941 = 0.09499080882. This is conditional on the stated model, not a browser guarantee.
preOutputRationale.negativeSensitivity: Wrong stamp/recovery/seed, R/B swap, ignored effect, premultiplied RGB returned as straight, alpha +1 and global one-channel +1 fail their relevant gates. A sparse hidden-RGB leak may pass scalar gates and must fail the exact transparent-pixel invariant.
preOutputRationale.limitation: No universal whole-shader f32/trigonometric error proof. Hard invariants and artifact fidelity checks are mandatory in addition to the scalar policies. Frozen expectations remain unchanged.

requiredBeforeRuntimeAcceptance: Fresh matching default and diagnostic WASM, actual raw API and default ABI absence
Serial real GPU execution and separate hard-invariant artifact audit
Host/editor persistence/history and independent encoded-video validation
